numbers.title: Phone numbers to scan
numbers.description: List of phone numbers in international E.164 format (e.g. +14155552671, +919876543210). Each number is scanned independently and produces one dataset record.

disableScanners.title: Disable scanners
disableScanners.description: Scanners to skip. Useful if you only want offline data (disable googlesearch, ovh, numverify, googlecse to get only local libphonenumber output).

numverifyApiKey.title: Numverify API key (optional)
numverifyApiKey.description: Your numverify.com API key. Without it the numverify scanner is skipped. Free tier: 100 lookups/month.

googleCseApiKey.title: Google CSE API key (optional)
googleCseApiKey.description: Google Custom Search Engine API key, paired with a CX id. Without both the googlecse scanner is skipped.

googleCseCx.title: Google CSE CX id (optional)
googleCseCx.description: Google CSE search engine identifier (cx). Paired with the Google CSE API key.
